name: Arlington Public Library Teen Volunteers
note: Re-verified against the library's own teen volunteer page on 2026-09-08. Openings are posted continuously on the library's volunteer portal; the page states no age or grade floor.

offerings.cycle_label: Rolling openings on the library volunteer portal - verified 2026-09-08
offerings.summary: Teens take posted library roles behind the scenes, at public programmes and at large events, applying independently through the library's volunteer portal; seniors doing a senior experience go through their guidance counsellor instead.

grades.raw: Explore opportunities for teens that build community connections, develop job skills and provide community service hours.

other: Senior Experience volunteers do not need to complete a library volunteer application
complete a teen library volunteer application independently

sched.hours_raw: shifts of two to three hours per week

app.instructions: View the teen volunteer openings on the library's volunteer portal and complete a teen library volunteer application independently. Seniors pursuing a senior experience should check with their guidance counsellor and the youth services librarian.

issues: This is the library's teen volunteer page; it publishes no minimum age or grade, so the high school range is taken from the page's framing and should be confirmed with the volunteer coordinator.
